title: MV Is there a way to move the position of sideview battlers WITHOUT the YEP Battle Engine Core? ( MV )

posts.author: ms_womp
posts.body:
So, from pretty much everything I've seen, the usual response to "how to move position of the sideview battlers" is to use YEPs Battle Engine Core, which is a really great plugin. HOWEVER, in my game (made in rpg maker mv), I have a different plugin, DoubleX RMMV Popularized ATB Core v104b if that matters, that YEPs Battle Engine Core messes with and makes it so it doesn't work. So I've been looking for some alternatives, but I haven't had much luck on my own search for some.
I know that the ATB Core plugin I'm using has ANOTHER plugin that fixes a lot of the compatibility issues between the two plugins, however it still kind of messes with a few things that just irk me a bit, so I'd HOPE that maaaybe I could skip the hassle and just get a different plugin, since pretty much the ONLY reason I have Battle Engine Core is for that "move position of sideview battlers" reason.
So tl;dr, I need a plugin that ISN'T YEPs Battle Engine Core that can move the position of the sideview battlers. Any help is appreciated lol

posts.author: Solar_Flare
posts.body:
You probably already have a plugin that does exactly that. If you got the engine on Steam, check out the dlc folder. In KadokawaPlugins there should be one called SVActorPosition.
There may be other similar plugins that add additional bells and whistles on top of that basic concept (like my as-yet-unreleased Party Battle Formations plugin), but maybe you don't need anything like that.
